name: 14B Feasibility Analysis + Capacity-First PRT Requirements
head: 1e4bd7091

impossible_model_demo_definition.goal: CPU-only 16GB RAM system runs a model that normally should not run — produces coherent output without OOM/swap death/cloud fallback
minimum_requirements: Speed does not need to beat native small models
candidate_tasks: Short factual answer: capital of France → Paris
Exact retrieval: retrieve embedded tracking ID from noisy context
impossible_model_demo_definition.success_condition: Native fails/swaps/OOMs; SDI/PRT capacity path produces coherent bounded output inside guard
impossible_model_demo_definition.failure_condition: Native works fine (not true feasibility target), candidate produces garbage, cloud/GPU required, swap death occurs

14b_feasibility_estimate.all_figures: ESTIMATES — no 14B model pulled or run
14b_feasibility_estimate.verdict: 14B at c=2048 is edge of possibility; c=4096+ likely fails; context SDI could help at lower contexts but base model weight size is fixed
14b_feasibility_estimate.key_question: Does 14B fail at load (weight footprint) or during generation (KV/context growth)? Preliminary: likely generation-time KV pressure at higher contexts

30b_contrast.native_path: Impossible on 16GB — model itself exceeds available RAM
30b_contrast.contrast: 14B = capacity problem (weights fit but barely); 30B = weight residency problem (weights don't fit at all)

what_context_sdi_can_help: KV pressure at high context (selects high-value tokens only)
Noisy history bloat (compresses filler, preserves pinned facts)
Factual retention under compression (structured packet format)
Active generation memory growth (memory guard prevents pressured runs)
what_context_sdi_cannot_help: Base model weight size (8-9GB is 8-9GB regardless of prompt)
Dense per-token weight streaming (SDI doesn't change weight load per forward pass)
Model load RAM (model must be in RAM before generation starts)
Q4 weight bandwidth (each token requires reading Q4 weights from RAM)
FFN/activation compute (SDI doesn't skip FFN layers)
KV at very high context (compressed context still has KV)
key_distinction: If 14B fails at load (weight footprint) → capacity-first PRT required. If 14B fails during generation (KV/context growth) → context SDI helps. 14B at c=2048 likely loads; failure mode is likely generation-time KV growth.

capacity_first_prt_requirements.core_requirement: Active memory representation of model must fit under strict budget — not load full model, represent in form that fits and activates only what's needed
hard_constraints: No full f32 expansion (doubles size, likely exceeds budget immediately)
No sidecar larger than what it replaces
Bounded working set — runtime knows exactly what's resident
Graceful degradation — fewer planes = lower quality but still coherent

six_design_requirements.name: Resident footprint reduction
six_design_requirements.description: Active representation must fit under strict memory budget (~8-10GB for 14B); consider low-rank factorization, structured sparsity, quantized residual planes

six_design_requirements.name: Progressive activation
six_design_requirements.description: Activate only required weight planes/blocks/channels per token; layer/block-level paging; sparse activation patterns skip FFN blocks; quality degrades gracefully

six_design_requirements.name: Backend/native layout awareness
six_design_requirements.description: Design around GGML/CPU memory layout from day one; GGML's tensor layout optimized for CPU cache lines; custom ops fighting this will lose; GGML's Q4_K_M may already be best starting point

six_design_requirements.name: Bounded working set with explicit budget
six_design_requirements.description: Every layer/block/weight page explicitly budgeted; runtime tracks active resident memory in real time; memory guard throttles/prefetchs/evicts before swap occurs

six_design_requirements.name: Verification/fallback
six_design_requirements.description: Short canary prompts detect collapse; compare against known baseline; fallback may be fewer planes, lower precision, or simpler model; never cloud/GPU

six_design_requirements.name: Out-of-core possibility
six_design_requirements.description: mmap/paging from fast storage (SSD) if RAM exceeded; explicit prefetch schedule for weight pages; avoid OS-managed swap; runtime controls paging, not accidental page faults

is_not: Old PRT custom-op speed path (speed not the goal)
Context compression or packetization (context SDI's job)
Dynamic quantization at runtime (pre-quantized weights only)

impossible_model_benchmark.native_baseline: Attempt model load at c=512, generate 20 tokens max, strict memory guard; record: load success/failure, swap delta, output sanity, wall time
impossible_model_benchmark.sdi_prt_candidate: Same environment, apply context SDI if applicable, capacity-first representation if available; record: RSS, swap delta, coherent output check, token rate, fallback triggered
impossible_model_benchmark.pass_criteria: Native fails/unusable AND candidate produces coherent answer for all 3 task types without swap death

recommended_next_phase: Phase 28F: 14B native feasibility preflight design + capacity gap analysis — still no 14B pull/run, design what preflight check would look like and analyze capacity gap
